dialogues.text: Ugh... It's the thought that counts.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Oz

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.text: Oh no... my stomach hurts...

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: I'm sorry... This meal isn't really agreeing with me.

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: I see. So this is your take on this dish...

dialogues.text: Here's a suggestion: Try using this dish in the hot pot game next time you play.

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.text: Mmm... It's delicious! Could you teach me?

dialogues.text: With skills like this, I bet you never go hungry when you're out in the wilderness, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Collei

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Oh, so my apprentice knows their way around the kitchen, huh? Alright, lemme order something...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: You expect me to eat this? Hmph, you'd better compensate me for the mental trauma!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Nice flavor pairing. Could you give me a copy of the recipe? I want to put this on the menu for the Forest Rangers' next meal.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: ...Do I need to teach you some new recipes?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: This must be what it feels like to have flavors dancing on your tongue... How wonderful!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.text: Tastes great. You have my gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: I accept. Thank you.

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Candace

dialogues.speaker: Candace

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Mm, may the world never forget this beautiful flavor. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Hehe, I really appreciate this. It tastes lovely.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.text: Mmm... it's really good.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Um... maybe we should just grab some takeout.

dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.text: It's okay. Guess this is one of the few things you're good at.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Not bad. You actually made something edible.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: You wanna poison me? Are you so dumb as to have forgotten that I'm not human?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Hm? This indescribable taste... Are you trying to get me to figure out what this is?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Sooo tasty! Next time you cook, lemme come too! I can help~

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: ...Uh, do you always eat this kind of stuff? Maybe you should let me cook for you instead! If you're not eating well and you're still going out adventuring every day, one of these days you're gonna wear yourself out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Hmm, a contemporary flavor. Not bad.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Let's not eat here. Mind if I... take it home?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: This tastes amazing! I'd better not have any more, or I'll never be able to go back to my usual rations.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Mmm, not bad... compared to rations, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: You know, if nothing else, it's uh... filling, and if it fills you up — it's good grub! Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Thanks so much... this is such a marvelous dish, I would feel terrible using it just to fill my stomach! Can I put it away for storage?

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: The taste and portions are both incredible. You really went the extra mile for me.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Ugh... well, since you went to the trouble of making this for me... I promise I'll finish it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please try this!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whooaa! That was the tastiest food in the whole wide world! You're the best!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mmm, tastes really good! Come and have some! Let's eat together.

dialogues.speaker: Nazafarin
dialogues.text: Ah, Lesser Lord Kusanali be praised! My thanks to you two, many thanks indeed!

choices.text: Could you remind me how to use this pot again?

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Right, yes, of course. A great hero such as yourself is rather busy, after all, perhaps too busy to remember such things. I did not consider that.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: It's actually quite simple. You simply need to add the correct seasonings at the right time.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: I'm sure you'll work it out once you try it.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: See you. Once again, you have Nazafarin's utmost thanks! May this go smoothly for you.
